2608.00181.title: Cross-Benchmark Generalization in Long-Horizon Agents
2608.00181.paper_summary: For reinforcement learning (RL) in self-contained environments, a policy can get rewards by exploiting environment-specific regularities (tool schemas, grader parsing, task templates) rather than by acquiring transferable skill, and an in-distribution holdout shares those regularities. We argue that the discriminating question is behavioral, namely how a trained agent acts, and that cross-benchmark transfer is the right place to look for it. We post-train an open-weight mixture-of-experts model (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) on 363 long-horizon Model Context Protocol (MCP) tasks across 27 categories, using a two-stage SFT-then-RL pipeline. Toolathlon performance informed the initial base-family and SFT-teacher choices, but no external-benchmark task or grader entered training and no external score informed the reward, training hyperparameters, trained-checkpoint selection, or stopping. At greedy pass@1, the trained model improves over the base on five reported external evaluations: Toolathlon (+9.6 pp), $τ^2$-Bench (+5.3 pp), BFCL-V4 (+3.5 pp), SWE-Bench Pro (+5.8 pp), and Terminal-Bench 2 (+2.8 pp). Both software-engineering benchmarks improve despite the training collection containing no software-engineering tasks. An exploratory paired-trajectory analysis identifies four recurring behavioral differences (more careful local-goal formation, building goal-relevant working state, keeping parent goals stable through local repairs, and verifying completion) that appear in analogous forms across office workflows and code. These results provide descriptive evidence that long-horizon multi-tool post-training can change ways of working that transfer beyond its training domain.
2608.00181.paper_summary_zh: 對於在自給自足環境中的強化學習（RL），策略可以通過利用環境特定的規律（工具架構、評分者解析、任務模板）來獲得獎勵，而不是通過獲得可轉移的技能，並且在分佈內的保留樣本共享這些規律。我們認為，關鍵的問題是行為性的，即訓練過的代理如何行動，而跨基準轉移是尋找它的正確地方。我們在363個長期模型上下文協議（MCP）任務中，跨27個類別對一個開放權重的專家混合模型（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）進行後訓練，使用兩階段的SFT然後RL管道。Toolathlon的表現為初始基礎家族和SFT教師選擇提供了信息，但沒有外部基準任務或評分者進入訓練，也沒有外部分數影響獎勵、訓練超參數、訓練檢查點選擇或停止。在貪婪的pass@1中，訓練模型在五個報告的外部評估中超越了基礎：Toolathlon（+9.6 pp）、$τ^2$-Bench（+5.3 pp）、BFCL-V4（+3.5 pp）、SWE-Bench Pro（+5.8 pp）和Terminal-Bench 2（+2.8 pp）。儘管訓練集不包含任何軟體工程任務，但兩個軟體工程基準仍然有所改進。一項探索性的配對軌跡分析識別了四個反覆出現的行為差異（更謹慎的局部目標形成、建立與目標相關的工作狀態、通過局部修復保持父目標穩定，以及驗證完成）這些差異在辦公工作流程和代碼中以類似的形式出現。這些結果提供了描述性證據，表明長期多工具後訓練可以改變超出其訓練領域的工作方式。
